Hi Pete,

Yes, a contra-deal works for me. Here is what I can do:

- The sponsor card for BA Creative on the Shopify monthly cost guide for 6 months, at no charge. Like every card on the site it is labelled "Sponsored".
- In exchange, one normal editorial link (not nofollow) to https://projectcostestimator.com/shopify-store-cost from a relevant post on the BA Creative blog, for example one about Shopify or website costs, kept in place for the same period.

Order of things: you send me the URL of the post once the link is in, plus the card material, and the card goes live within one working day.

For the card I need a square logo (PNG or SVG), a headline of up to 70 characters, two short lines of copy, button text and the destination URL.

If you would rather have the card for 12 months, the paid option I sent earlier still stands.

Florin Florea
founder, Project Cost Estimator
